summary: Armor-stacking tank with annoying Q poke and a game-changing R. Safe and poke-heavy in lane but low kill pressure alone. Magic damage, true damage, and %HP damage beat him; auto-attackers struggle.
threats: Q (Seismic Shard) is point-and-click poke that steals your move speed.
E (Ground Slam) cuts your attack speed and scales with his armor.
Granite Shield (passive) absorbs your first hit; it returns if he goes ~10s unhit.
R (Unstoppable Force) at 5: a gank or teamfight engage from long range. Track it.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser deals magic damage, so Malphite's armor stacking does nothing. R (Realm of Death) isolates Malphite where nobody can save him, and steals his stats.
trading: Q (Obliterate) the moment his Granite Shield is down; isolated Q hits hard.
When he Qs you, walk forward and trade back; you win any extended trade.
E (Death's Grasp) pull into Q when he walks up to last-hit.
Use W (Indestructible) after taking poke to recover HP.
matchups.early: Win the wave and trade freely. He can poke but can't stop your all-in.
matchups.spike: At 5, R removes him from his jungler's help and steals his armor and HP. A 1v1 in the Realm is almost always yours.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash into his tower to deny farm and plates.
matchups.jungle: You don't need ganks to win. Ward river; his R can turn a gank on your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Magic-pen bruiser items; boots that suit the enemy team comp.
matchups.remember: He builds armor; you deal magic. Don't let him farm for free.

matchups.why: Gwen's magic damage and the true-damage centre of Q ignore Malphite's armor, so his main defensive stat is wasted. W (Hallowed Mist) blocks his Q poke from outside the mist, and he has no way to out-trade her.
trading: Stack Q with autos, then land the centre of the final snip for true damage.
Pop W when he Qs you to block the poke.
E (Skip 'n Slash) to close distance and hit his shield before trading.
matchups.early: Trade with full-stack Q and back off before his E slows your attack speed.
matchups.spike: At 5, your R adds ranged damage and you outscale him in side lane; his R is only a threat with his jungler.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when the wave is with you.
matchups.jungle: Ward river; play near your jungler when his R is up.

matchups.why: Garen's damage is physical and Malphite's armor reduces it, but Garen's passive regen undoes most of his poke. Neither champion can really kill the other alone, so it plays out as a farm lane.
trading: Don't stand in front of the wave; his Q poke resets your regen.
Q into E only after his shield is down; your spin pops it fast.
When he uses E on you, back off. Your attack speed is crippled.
matchups.early: Even. Farm and look for short Q + E trades when his Q (Seismic Shard) is on cooldown.
matchups.spike: At 5, your R can execute him after your jungler engages. His R is an engage threat for his jungler.
matchups.wave: Slow-push to keep pressure; stay out of his engage range.
matchups.jungle: Ward river; play near your jungler when his R is up.

matchups.why: Jax's damage comes from autos and on-hit, exactly what Malphite's armor and E (Ground Slam) attack-speed slow shut down. Malphite's Q is targeted spell poke that Counter Strike can't dodge, so Jax gets chipped every time he walks up.
trading: Hit his Granite Shield with one auto before any trade; don't start a fight into the shield.
Use E (Counter Strike) as you Leap in to absorb his Ground Slam's AoE damage, then stun.
Trade only while his E is on cooldown; once your attack speed is slowed, walk away.
Don't chase him through his wave; he Q-pokes and walks off with your speed.
matchups.early: Concede some poke and farm. One short Leap + Counter Strike trade when his E is down is fine; extended fights aren't.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R makes all-ins closer, but his R lets his jungler kill you. Respect his R before stepping up.
matchups.wave: Let him push into you and farm under tower; your scaling outlasts his lane pressure.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape besides R. If you can get him low while his R is down, your jungler can finish him.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Rush a damage item, then mix in bruiser items; don't overbuild attack speed early, since his E cuts it anyway.
matchups.remember: Pop the shield first, trade only when his E is down.

matchups.why: Tryndamere is pure autos and crit, and Malphite's armor plus E (Ground Slam) slow deletes his damage. Malphite's targeted Q also chips him for free, while Tryndamere's Fury only grows if he trades.
trading: Use Q (Bloodlust) to heal off Malphite's poke instead of trading back at low Fury.
Only E (Spinning Slash) in when his Ground Slam is on cooldown; reset it on crits.
Back off after his E lands; your autos are crippled for the duration.
W (Mocking Shout) to slow him if he tries to walk you down.
matchups.early: Farm, build Fury, and heal off poke. Don't take trades into a full Granite Shield.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R keeps you alive in an all-in, but his R lets his jungler commit too. Track his level.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower; you want to reach items and split-push later, not win lane.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks when his R is on cooldown; your R prevents you dying in a 2v2.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo or Conqueror. Armor pen early; crit items once he stops itemizing pure armor.
matchups.remember: Heal through the poke and split-push later.
